entry.title: Generate truly random seed words using only dice or playing cards
entry.summary: The email provides clarification on the number of dice rolls intended for a game or simulation, specifying that there should be three rolls in total: two of these rolls will utilize two dice each, and one roll will involve just one die. The sender also indicates that the current document serves more as a specification rather than a comprehensive guide. They express openness to developing it further into a detailed guide if there is sufficient interest or engagement from the community. This approach suggests a phased development process where initial feedback plays a critical role in determining the extent of future expansions or enhancements to the document.
